title: MC23s Resource Pack
description: A resource pack made for the players on the MC23 that adds many features used frequently on the server
body:
![Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d00179ae0daa92d74ae063586af45fbce47f98a9_0.webp)
![A diamond blue line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1892af69bbbc9eac874f0534095694313cbfcf9e.png) [![Immediately Fast button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bdb9cd360708c0c6befab0d3e92304287a7117e.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) !["Required" text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/856f21b1b60469cbb66790fbb4ac27d1706da5c5.png)

![A diamond blue line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1892af69bbbc9eac874f0534095694313cbfcf9e.png) ![a symbol for "about this pack"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/613fd394d4cd4de38b0e3a7235773f888ad6d536.png) # About the pack: MC23s resource pack is made for the server MC23 and is **probably nothing intresting for those who are not whitelisted on the server.** This pack adds alot of things so click the "Everything added/changed in this pack" spoiler or go to the gallery to see everything.
Everything added/changed in this pack
![a heart icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba3715c690a3a8eb79a82559c8608dcf840b199b.png) ### Icons: 不 = A logo of a company in the MC23 server (Pear Inc).\ 人 = The first ever logo of the MC23 server.\ 下 = The latest logo of the MC23 server.\ 大 = A classic Mumbo Jumbo mustache.
![a diamond pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/010e3e2f6e5fbcb6900c71e2fc1ef292c4074f78.png) ### Custom items: If you rename a redstone dust to "Macintosh" you get a, you guessed it, Macintosh.\ If you rename a diamond sword to "Rumi sword" you get Rumi's sword from the Netflix show 'Kpop demon hunters'.\ If you rename a carved pumpkin to "Jojos lilla hatt" you get a classic, high hat to put on you head.\ If you rename a carved pumpkin to any players username on the server, if you put that in an item frame you get a statue of the player.\ (Note! The names are case sensitive)\
![a painting item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7667627564ef10722f58e89c15d06a1bdb17c511.png) ### Paintings: The 'Target Successfully Bombed' painting is now the first logo of the server MC23\ The 'Wanderer' painting is now a vending machine, where you can get our servers own cola.\ The 'Changing' painting is now the latest logo of the server MC23\ The 'Fighters' painting is now a TV with the classic high quality video on.\
![a grass block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e752fee9cce4442b2db782c777e45d115b123849_0.webp) ### Everything else: Mushroom stew is now a cola drink can.\ Bowls are now a "crumbled" version of the cola can.\ The splash texts are now things we on the MC23 server find funny.\ The background menu panorama is now a panorama of the MC23 server.\ The title now says "Minecraft MC23 Edition" with "MC23 edition" being golden. A transparent carved pumpkin overlay is also included as this pack uses carved pumpkins alot.\

![A command block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1ad2d49377ee0904cf48a363928b465c6e73d86_0.webp) # For devs: Hi! Im glad you like my assets and want to include them in your own resource packs! You can absolutely do that, just read the content of the "License" spoiler first, (i would also love to see the pack so if you want just send me a link on Discord, my dc name is DmaxB).
